type score_structural_alerts = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string,

alert_library?: "all" | "pains" | "pains_a" | "pains_b" | "pains_c" | "brenk" | "nih" | "zinc" | "chembl" | "chembl_bms" | "chembl_lint" | "chembl_mlsmr"

type get_labute_asa = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return fraction of aromatic atoms.
type get_fraction_aromatic_atoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_num_heterocycles = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return aromatic heterocycle count.
type get_num_aromatic_heterocycles = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return atom stereocenter count.
type get_num_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Bertz complexity index.
type get_bertz_ct = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa1 = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

smiles: string
